findings.text: Tail of anonymous mapping creation validates special volatile flavor, applies noreserve policy including overcommit and huge page file handling, delegates range installation to the region creator, and reports populate length when the area is locked or synchronously populated.

Volatile anonymous flavor refuses locked requests, huge page requests and growable flag combinations, records no reserve plus wipe on fork plus no dump attributes, then derives the anonymous offset from the start address scaled by page size.

Unmapped area selection first runs architecture checks, rejects oversized lengths, chooses a file helper or shared anonymous helper when available, otherwise uses transparent huge page alignment for suitable large anonymous requests or the generic allocator, then enforces task range and page alignment before the security address check.
Anonymous address selection always treats the file offset as zero regardless of caller input, while file backed selection preserves the supplied offset for the chosen allocator.

Checked region installer enforces write execute denial and architecture flag acceptance, establishes temporary writability on shared writable file mappings, invokes the core installer, always releases the temporary writability, and validates the address space before returning.
Region installation requires the current address space to be held in write mode on entry; the implementation asserts that condition.

Core installation moves from setup and optional driver prepare through early mergeability assessment and neighbour merge attempt to either reuse or new allocation, then completion callbacks and action finalization, with distinct unwind that uncharges memory and detaches partial state on failure.

Setup phase locates overlap, builds a detach collection for conflicting ranges, resolves neighbours, checks address space growth and private writable charging including security approval, clears conflicting page tables and closes displaced areas, then publishes range and protection into the descriptor.
Memory charging applies only to private writable areas without noreserve; huge page files are never charged here because they use separate accounting.

Mapping operation state carries address space, iterator, start and derived end, file and anonymous offsets, page length, flags, file reference and derived protection; merge view additionally carries neighbours, middle area and merge start state.

With memory management enabled, completion handles no action as success, delegates page frame remapping and kernel page mapping to dedicated completers, and treats input output remap flavors as delegation errors with a one time warning.
Without memory management, completion accepts only the no action flavor and rejects all remap or kernel mapping flavors with a one time warning and invalid argument failure.

Action finalization invokes the mapped notification on success, releases any rmap hold, returns immediately on success or compatibility handling, and otherwise tears down the freshly created area while honouring an override error when present.
Mapped notification is optional; when the operation provides it, the area range and file offset plus file and private data are offered, failure propagates, and an updated private pointer is adopted.

Memory unmapping entry validates page alignment and task bounds, aligns length upward, treats empty results as invalid, returns success when no overlap exists, and otherwise delegates aligned teardown of the overlapping span.
When no virtual area overlaps the requested span, unmapping succeeds without change, releasing the write hold when the caller requested unlock behaviour.

No memory management unmapping requires non empty page aligned length, locates the first overlap, warns in a rate limited way and fails when nothing overlaps, enforces whole area erasure for file backed ranges and subset containment with alignment for anonymous ranges, splitting middle punches before shrinking.
Splitting is permitted only for anonymous areas; file backed areas cannot be split, middle removal requires a prior split, and map count limits can refuse the new piece.
Whole area deletion detaches the area from the address space tree and list, decrements the map count, closes operations, drops file and backing region references, and frees the area object.
Insertion and removal of file backed areas in the address space reverse map are serialized by the mapping write lock with cache maintenance held across the tree update.
All backing region tree mutation and reference count changes occur under the global region semaphore in write mode, including add, erase, split, shrink and release paths.

Backing regions are reference counted; last release removes non empty entries from the tree, drops the file reference, frees copied pages only for mapped copy regions, and returns the object to its cache.

Backing regions are ordered by start address in a balanced tree; inserting the same object is a no operation while a different object with identical start is a fatal consistency error, with validation before and after mutation in the checking build.
Region validation either enforces start before end, top coverage and non overlapping increasing order with fatal checks, or compiles to an empty operation depending on build configuration.

Anonymous split duplicates the area and backing region, partitions bounds and offsets according to whether the new piece is below, invokes the open notification, replaces both region entries atomically under lock, links both areas to the address space, stores the new area and accounts the extra map.
Anonymous shrinking clears the truncated span from the tree, adjusts the surviving bound, resizes the backing region under lock with tree replacement, and releases the trimmed pages.

Backing region tracks base, committed end and reservation top bounds, file offset, usage count, flags, file link and tree node; virtual area links to its region and address space with start and end bounds and file link.

Aborted setup with no detached pages does nothing; with cleared page tables it reattaches detached areas, otherwise it leaves an empty gap in place of the failed fixed mapping and completes teardown bookkeeping.
Teardown preparation does nothing when no pages were detached; otherwise it clears page tables while areas remain visible to reverse mapping and then closes each detached area.
Descriptor publication copies start, end, offset, file, flags and protection from the prepared mapping state.
Neighbour lookup returns the next area and optionally the previous area, rewinding the iterator to the start of the gap when a previous area exists so iteration does not skip.
Failures are signalled with EINVAL for invalid flags alignment or bounds and with ENOMEM for growth charging or allocation shortage and with EACCES for write execute denial.
Kernel same page merging flags are refreshed from address space and file context after early eligibility was recorded during setup.
Finalization releases any held reverse map lock before invoking unmapping on the error path because teardown can acquire that lock.
Shrinking assumes exclusive backing region ownership; shared use would violate the single user expectation enforced by a fatal check.
